python.notes: standard library only; no pip packages

git.notes: folder scans skip gitignored files and doctor checks .gitignore; without git both are skipped

vale.notes: pinned release, SHA-256 verified on download; every other check runs without it

vale-styles.notes: synced into <repo>/.vale/styles by deploy, which also removes style folders that are no longer pinned

claude-code.worker: humanize-editor agent, model opus, effort high
claude-code.notes: loads skills and agents at session start; start a new session after deploy

codex-cli.notes: on Linux hosts that restrict unprivileged user namespaces (Ubuntu 24.04+ default), Codex's bubblewrap sandbox cannot start; allow bwrap in AppArmor or set sandbox_mode = "danger-full-access" in $CODEX_HOME/config.toml. doctor warns when this applies

network.notes: Vale download and style sync; runs need no network (workers use their own provider)

environment.HUMANIZE_PYTHON: Python 3.9+ to use for the launcher and deploy.sh
environment.HUMANIZE_CODEX_BIN: codex CLI to use for Codex workers
environment.XDG_CACHE_HOME: base for the optional user-level Vale config (humanize setup --user); default ~/.cache
environment.PYTHONUTF8: set to 1 by the launcher; the tool also switches to UTF-8 itself under a non-UTF-8 locale
